第967章 飞船遗迹，‘渊’的尸骸，归家-《废土藏身处，从下水道开始升级》
第967章 飞船遗迹，‘渊’的尸骸，归家-《废土藏身处，从下水道开始升级》
“夜鹰飞船信号消失，检测到西13区域爆发超高强度能量波动，能级接近5千万马特尔……”
“5千万马特尔的能量强度.......这已经达到极限了吧。瓦塔他们根本不可能承受，难道又有一名新的神话级诞生了？”这是一名机械生命超维。
“不，我们没检测到神话级能量波动，刚才的攻击，也是通过某种装置释放，是比我们更加先进的机械装置。”
“先是血腥主宰屠戮血肉生命，之后又是5大神话级混战。好不容易等到一切风平浪静，现在却冒出这样一个强大的家伙，不管如何，先将情况告知执行官阁下吧！ ”
“将西13区划定为禁行区域，暂时不要与对方发生正面冲突，这个文明长阶宇宙，很可能拥有神话级存在，否则不会如此强横。”
一座机械王座之上，人形机械生命体接收到关于这次探索的相关数据和分析后，睁开了鲜红色的电子眼。
“不久前血腥主宰屠戮的方向似乎也是在西13区，但没过多久他的与火焰城主他们战斗在了一起，现在又出现这样一个文明要塞。”
“新世界还真是危险啊！神话级存在的冲突都如此频繁？还是说只是这座森林会是这样。”
“塞坦宇宙已经完全干涸，资源枯竭，族群的实力已经发展到了巅峰，但放在整个新世界还是有些孱弱，若是能占据一个新的文明宇宙，却是一个不错的选择。”
“这个文明长阶宇宙如此强大，并且让血腥主宰都十分重视，这个宇宙或许就是一个不错的目标。”
最后他决定先多观察一些时日再说，另外他也要做些准备，看能不能想办法驱狼吞虎，削弱文明长阶实力和底蕴。

Chapter 967: The remains of the spaceship, the corpse of ‘Abyss’, returning home - "Wasteland Hideout, Upgrading from the Sewer"
Chapter 967: The remains of the spaceship, the corpse of ‘Abyss’, returning home - "Wasteland Hideout, Upgrading from the Sewer"
"The signal of the Nighthawk spacecraft disappeared, and an ultra-high-intensity energy fluctuation was detected in the West 13 area. The energy level was close to 50 million matels..."
"The energy intensity of 50 million matels... this has reached the limit. It is impossible for Watta and the others to bear it. Is there a new mythical level born?" This is a super-dimensional mechanical life.
"No, we did not detect myth-level energy fluctuations. The attack just now was also released through some kind of device. It was a more advanced mechanical device than us."
"First, the Blood Lord slaughtered flesh and blood, and then there was a melee of five mythical levels. It took us a long time to wait until everything was calm, but now such a powerful guy appears. No matter what, please inform the Executive Officer of the situation first! "
"Describe the West 13th District as a prohibited area, and do not have a head-on conflict with the other party for the time being. This long-term civilization universe is likely to have mythical existences, otherwise it would not be so tyrannical."
On a mechanical throne, the humanoid mechanical life form opened its bright red electronic eyes after receiving relevant data and analysis about this exploration.
"Not long ago, the direction of the bloody master's slaughter seemed to be in the West 13th District, but not long after, he fought with the Flame City Lord and the others, and now such a civilized fortress appears again."
"The new world is really dangerous! Are conflicts among mythical existences so frequent? Or is it just this forest?"
"The Sethan universe has been completely dried up and its resources have been exhausted. The strength of the ethnic group has reached its peak, but it is still a bit weak in the entire new world. If it can occupy a new civilized universe, it is a good choice."
"This civilized long-term universe is so powerful, and the bloody master attaches great importance to it. This universe may be a good target."
In the end, he decided to observe it for a while longer. In addition, he also wanted to make some preparations to see if he could find a way to drive away the wolf and weaken the long-term strength and foundation of the civilization.
